{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WST-052","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"R 40±0.1"}],"comment":"Dimension D11 specifies a radius (R 40±0.1) for what is likely the spherical end of the stop pin, but it is not marked as a sphere. Without the sphere designation the machinist may produce a cylindrical fillet instead of a spherical surface, causing the pin to fail its locating function. Change the callout to include the sphere symbol, e.g. 'SR 40±0.1' or '40ϕ Sphere'."
    , "recommended_correction": "Change R 40±0.1 to SR 40±0.1 or equivalent sphere notation."}]}
